from math import gcd

def _convergents(p, q):
    quot = []
    a, b = p, q
    while b:
        quot.append(a // b)
        a, b = b, a % b
    conv = []
    hm2, hm1 = 0, 1
    km2, km1 = 1, 0
    for a in quot:

        k = a * km1 + km2
        conv.append((h, k))
        hm2, hm1 = hm1, h
        km2, km1 = km1, k
    return conv

def check_case(case):

    q = case['q']
    expect = case['expect_claim']
    ok = isinstance(p, int) and isinstance(q, int) and p > 0 and q > p and gcd(p, q) == 1
    claim = False
    if ok:
        conv = _convergents(p, q)
        det_ok = True
        grow_ok = True
        for i in range(1, len(conv)):
            h0, k0 = conv[i - 1]
            h1, k1 = conv[i]
            if abs(h1 * k0 - h0 * k1) != 1:
                det_ok = False
